source: PROGRAM/FLAWS.md 0.1.0, FLAW-0006 example (all horses have the same colour): executor-authored synthetic material, outside the S1 corpus (ADR-0011 D6)
title: All horses have the same colour
statement: For every $n \ge 1$, in any set of $n$ horses all the horses have the same colour.
counterexample: Two horses of different colours: for $n = 2$ the set of both is not monochromatic.
binders: (H : Type) [DecidableEq H] (colour : H → ℕ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
claim: ∀ s : Finset H, s.card = n → ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ b ∈ s, colour a = colour b

steps.text: We argue by induction on $n$. Base case $n = 1$: a set of one horse is trivially monochromatic.
fragment: induction n with
| zero => omega
| succ m ih =>
intro s hs a ha b hb
by_cases hab : a = b
· rw [hab]
· rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with hm | hm
· subst hm
obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hs
rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at ha hb
exact absurd (ha.trans hb.symm) hab

steps.text: Induction step: let $S$ be a set of $n + 1$ horses and let $a, b \in S$ (if $a = b$ there is nothing to show). Removing $b$ leaves $n$ horses, which share a colour by the induction hypothesis; so do the $n$ horses left after removing $a$.
fragment: · have h1 : ∀ x ∈ s.erase b, ∀ y ∈ s.erase b, colour x = colour y := ih hm (s.erase b) (by simp [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hb, hs])
have h2 : ∀ x ∈ s.erase a, ∀ y ∈ s.erase a, colour x = colour y := ih hm (s.erase a) (by simp [Finset.card_erase_of_mem ha, hs])

steps.text: These two sets of $n$ horses overlap: together they omit only $a$ and $b$, so their overlap has $n - 1 \ge 1$ horses. Take a horse $z$ in both.
fragment: have hcard : (s.erase a ∩ s.erase b).card + 2 = s.card := by
rw [Finset.erase_inter, Finset.inter_erase, Finset.inter_self, Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hab, ha⟩), Finset.card_erase_of_mem hb]
omega
obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : (s.erase a ∩ s.erase b).Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)

steps.text: Then $a$ and $z$ share a colour, and $z$ and $b$ share a colour; hence $a$ and $b$ share a colour, so all $n + 1$ horses agree.
fragment: have hza : z ∈ s.erase a := (Finset.mem_inter.mp hz).1
have hzb : z ∈ s.erase b := (Finset.mem_inter.mp hz).2
calc colour a = colour z := h1 a (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hab, ha⟩) z hzb
_ = colour b := h2 z hza b (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm hab, hb⟩)
